parameters.name: BeginTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance to which the topic of the message belongs.

parameters.name: MsgKey
parameters.description: The message key of the message to query.

parameters.name: Topic
parameters.description: The topic of the message to query.
